physicalContract: One crescent-and-star clip only, fixed to the front-outer anatomical-left ear base.
The front view places it on viewer right; the anatomical-left profile shows it and the opposite profile occludes it.
The strict back view exposes only a small rear clasp or edge, never the complete ornament.
No side swapping, duplication, floating, penetration, or rear placement.

generation.designBoard: Eight-view shadowless orthographic turnaround of the same seated NAVA cat with one warm-gold crescent moon and tiny star clipped to the anatomical-left ear.

views.front: Strict front; ornament fully readable on viewer right.
views.left: Cat faces viewer left; anatomical-left ornament is far-side and almost fully occluded.
views.back: Strict back; only a small rear clasp edge is visible on viewer left.
views.right: Cat faces viewer right; anatomical-left ornament is near-side and fully visible.
